test_camera_reset: test the habitat robot camera reset function to verify pan and tilt return to zero
test_camera_position_control: test the robot camera pan and tilt position control with parametrized target positions
test_get_images: test the robot camera RGB and depth image capture and verify sensor resolution shapes
test_camera_matrix: test the robot camera intrinsics matrix calculation against expected focal length and principal point
test_pix_to_3dpt: test the pixel to 3D point conversion in both base and camera coordinate frames
test_pcd: test the point cloud generation from RGB-D images in base and camera coordinate frames
test_absolute_position_control: test the robot base absolute position control to navigate to target x, y, theta poses
test_relative_position_control: test the robot base relative position control to navigate from current pose by delta offsets
